verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents a `/memory` command, persistent GEMINI.md context files, and conversation checkpointing to save and resume sessions, so it has its own cross-session memory mechanisms. Nothing shows the agent building or recalling that memory automatically; GEMINI.md is user-authored, checkpointing is a save/resume action, and one user reports the CLI ignores GEMINI.md despite saying it is loaded. Missing for 10: documentation that the agent writes memories automatically, details of how `/memory` stores and recalls information across sessions, and independent hands-on confirmation that recall works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: Custom context files (GEMINI.md) to tailor behavior for your projects
